mutations.label: VA the _GATE_OWNER key is renamed, so `deliverability_ui_flow_missing` has no owner entry and falls back to 'NO remediation owner' -- the state #280 fixed. Owned by THIS file, which extracts the dict literal by AST; `test_284`'s `"..." in src` line cannot see it, because the same string sits on 4 comment/docstring lines in that module (including `_ui_flow_missing_extra`'s own docstring). A MISSED only ever says THIS file did not catch it, so the owner had to be found before calling it a gap.

VB the owner spec stops being a 3-tuple, so a consumer unpacking (owner, title, body) raises inside the dispatcher instead of dispatching. test_280 asserts the shape by AST, which is why the shape can be asserted at all.
